Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.auth

Interface Principal

All Known Implementing Classes:
SystemPrincipal, UserPrincipal
public sealed interface Principal permits UserPrincipal, SystemPrincipal
The authenticated principal of an incoming request (design §8.4 / §8.6).

Sealed sum type with two members:

  • UserPrincipal — a JWT-authenticated end user (delivered by EPIC-03).
  • SystemPrincipal — an API-key-authenticated machine principal (delivered by EPIC-04 / US-04-001).

The sealed hierarchy is closed: any call site that switches on Principal can do so exhaustively without a default branch, which is how the SYSTEM authorization rules of design §8.6 stay statically checked.
